Title: How I Trigger AI Workflows From My Phone
Description:
Send a text from your phone and kick off an AI workflow without opening your laptop.

In this video, I connect sent.dm to Cloudflare’s Agentic Inbox so an incoming message triggers a webhook, parses a tag, runs an AI content workflow, and saves the result to Notion. I also show how I use Browser Run and Workers AI to turn content ideas into directions for videos, blogs, and shorts.
